payload.interpretation: All twelve candidates and twelve fixed paired contrasts are descriptive retrospective development comparisons. Weights were fixed in design124922 before NBH errors were computed. No weight selection, training, inference, financial promotion, untouched-test claim or first-publication claim. A missing physical forecast removes that same case from all twelve candidates and requires common-subset recalibration. Original full-panel E022 scores remain separate.

evaluation.metric_weighting: Equal UTC target-day weight, equal case weight within each day; RMSE is the square root of day-weighted squared error.
evaluation.point_metric_basis: Raw baseline point forecasts or pretrained/fitted neural medians before quantile calibration.
